races.paceDynamic: Prince Andorra is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gate in this claiming maiden. With no obvious pace pressure, he can settle into a comfortable rhythm through the early stages, allowing the prominent runners Mo Anam Chara and Queen Of Newark to track within striking distance. The majority of the field consists of hold-up horses who will be relying on a strong finish, but they face the challenge of making up ground against a potentially uncontested leader. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early and avoid getting caught up in traffic problems late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prince Andorra Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Andorra breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure from the prominent runners.
scenarios.body: He can dictate a moderate tempo that suits his stamina reserves, with the hold-up horses struggling to close the gap in time. The uncontested leader scenario plays directly into his hands despite his modest ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If Mo Anam Chara or Queen Of Newark press Prince Andorra early and establish better position.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more honest, setting up perfectly for horses tracking in second or third to strike in the final furlong. This moderate tempo suits the prominent runners who can avoid the kick-back from Prince Andorra.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling through the middle stages.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the hold-up horses with the best turn of foot can unleash their finishing kick. Star Of Beauty and Cosmic Funk would benefit most from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Due In June or Monamie show significant improvement from their debuts with better tactical positioning.
scenarios.body: The lightly raced horses could have untapped ability that allows them to overcome the pace scenario. Their unknown running styles could prove more effective than their debut showings suggested.

watchPoints.text: Prince Andorra's early positioning is crucial - if he misses the break or gets headed early, his chances diminish rapidly given the lack of other pace.
Mo Anam Chara's tactics in the first two furlongs will determine if this becomes a truly-run race or allows Prince Andorra to coast.
Star Of Beauty's visor is applied for the first time which could sharpen her focus and improve her finishing kick.
The hold-up majority means traffic problems are likely in the straight, particularly affecting Cosmic Funk and Schoolyard Days.
Due In June and Monamie represent the biggest unknowns and any market support would suggest significant improvement expected.

races.paceDynamic: Thrifty Of Digby will lead from the gates with no genuine pace pressure from this field of mostly hold-up horses and mid-division runners. The prominent runners Mercurial, Free Solo, Irish Rumour, Queen Aethelflaed and Royal Impact will sit within 3-4 lengths but lack the pace to hassle the leader early. With 11 of 18 runners showing hold-up tendencies, the pace will be steady through the middle sections before quickening late. This sustainable gallop strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the massive pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Thrifty Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby maintains his uncontested lead without folding
scenarios.body: Shane Foley can dictate fractions and kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still finding racing room. The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to save enough for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the mid-race pace quickens enough to stretch Thrifty Of Digby
scenarios.body: The prominent runners Irish Rumour and Free Solo can track the leader's move and respond when he comes under pressure. Their forward positions give them first run on the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a bunched field turning for home where one hold-up horse finds clear running. Blue Anthem or Bucaneer's Spirit could benefit from their riders' low claim reducing their burden.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If even Thrifty Of Digby goes too slowly and gets swamped
scenarios.body: The entire field comes together in a mad dash where fitness and recent form matter most. Loingseoir's recent Roscommon win gives him the best chance of the closers.

races.paceDynamic: Galileo Springs will set the pace from the front with several prominent runners like Karrygrant, Noble Honour, and Changing Lanes tracking close behind, creating a modest gallop early. The presence of multiple hold-up horses including It's Good To Talk, Gaelic Drills, and Huff'n'puff suggests the pace will be reasonable rather than strong, allowing the leaders to maintain their advantage. With 17 runners but only one confirmed front-runner, Galileo Springs can dictate terms without early pressure, setting up a tactical affair where positioning will be crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with early pace who can track the leader, as the modest gallop will make it difficult for hold-up horses to close from the back of this large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Galileo Springs sets a steady pace without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The reasonable tempo allows prominent runners to save energy and kick clear in the straight, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close the gap from deep in the field. Those tracking the leader are perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Galileo Springs gets an uncontested lead and quickens approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The experienced front-runner uses class and tactical speed to stretch the field, with his recent form suggesting he can sustain a strong gallop. Hold-up horses are left with too much to do in a large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and bunches the field approaching the straight
scenarios.body: A slow tempo allows the hold-up horses to close the gap and utilize their finishing kicks in a cavalry charge finish. The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Longshot Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and favorites get caught in traffic
scenarios.body: Chaos ensues in the straight with several runners having chances, allowing a less-fancied runner to slip through and capitalize on a messy finish. Form gets thrown out the window.

races.paceDynamic: Adel will lead from the start with only Tenacious showing prominent tendencies, creating a very manageable early pace in this handicap. The tempo will be comfortable through the first mile with no pressure on the front-runner, allowing the large field of hold-up horses to settle behind. The race will develop into a staying test from the home turn as 12 of the 14 runners come from off the pace, creating a cavalry charge finish. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina and a strong finishing kick.

scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup with plenty left in the tank for a sustained drive. Fresh horses with strong finishes like Survivor's Code and Wipeawayyourtears capitalize on their light weights.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Adel stops quickly when challenged and creates a messy pace scenario
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace setters leaves a tactical vacuum that benefits horses who can adapt quickest. Versatile types like Femme Beauty and Sea Of Dubka find the gaps as the field bunches.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If someone takes on Adel early and creates genuine pace throughout
scenarios.body: The strong gallop exposes horses lacking stamina at this extended trip while rewarding proven stayers. Onyeisi and Survivor's Code benefit from their staying credentials.

scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Tassarolo or Mapa can track Prom Queen and pounce late
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid the worst of the traffic while staying close enough to strike in the final furlong when the pace lifts. Their tactical positioning proves crucial with so many hold-up horses struggling for clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If one of the stronger hold-up horses like Grey Fable gets a dream run through
scenarios.body: A perfectly-timed run from the back finds the right gap at the crucial moment while others are still trapped. The class advantage of horses like Grey Fable or Miss Australie could tell if they get the racing luck.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and causes a sprint finish scramble
scenarios.body: The large field creates total mayhem in the straight with multiple horses blocked and jockeys taking desperate measures. An outsider who finds racing room could steal victory in the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Prom Queen could steal this if allowed to dictate her own fractions from the front with minimal early pressure
Traffic problems will be severe in the straight with 13 hold-up horses needing racing room on this turning track
Tassarolo and Mapa are the key prominent runners who could track the leader and avoid the worst congestion
Several horses marked as faders including Edge Of Darkness, Miss Australie and Al What make poor betting propositions
The 588-day absence for Burlington House makes this return virtually impossible despite the jockey booking
